valid.description: The same payload with the signatures in the other order. Same hash, same approvals.

valid.name: half-signed
valid.description: One signature. This is what passes between phones.

valid.name: retired-mid-match
valid.description: Best of 5, retired by player 1 with fewer games than best_of, the last one unfinished.

valid.name: retired-before-any-game
valid.description: Retired by player 0 before any game ended. games is empty.

valid.name: correction
valid.description: A correction of completed-best-of-3. replaces is that result's hash.

valid.description: An unrated match with one signature.

valid.name: merged-player
valid.description: Names a player that a merge later points at another player.
valid.note: Valid at the format level. Don't refuse it: the server resolves the player through merged_into.

valid.name: one-key-for-both-players
valid.description: One key approves for both players, as one account that represents both does.

valid.name: two-keys-for-one-player
valid.description: Two keys approve for player 0: the player's own and a representative's.

valid.name: same-signature-twice
valid.description: The same COSE_Signature twice. approvals has one entry.

invalid.name: tampered-payload
invalid.description: iat is one second later, re-encoded deterministically, with both signatures kept. Neither verifies.

invalid.name: unknown-kid
invalid.description: The second signature is by a key the directory doesn't hold.

invalid.name: payload-reencoded-in-another-map-order
invalid.description: The second signer re-encoded the payload with the result map's keys in reverse order and signed that.

invalid.name: payload-integer-not-shortest
invalid.description: best_of as the two bytes 0x18 0x03.

invalid.name: unknown-result-key
invalid.description: The result map has a key 9.

invalid.name: result-key-as-text
invalid.description: Text "1" in place of the integer key 1. A JavaScript decoder that builds plain objects accepts it.

invalid.name: equal-player-ids
invalid.description: Both players are the same player.

invalid.name: retired-by-without-retirement
invalid.description: ending 0 with retired_by present.

invalid.name: retirement-without-retired-by
invalid.description: ending 1 without retired_by.

invalid.name: match-id-as-uuid-tag
invalid.description: The match id as tag 37 around its 16 bytes.

invalid.name: rated-as-integer
invalid.description: rated as the integer 1 instead of true.

invalid.name: issued-at-as-float
invalid.description: iat as a float64, as Date.now() / 1000 makes it.

invalid.name: tag-18
invalid.description: COSE_Sign1's tag in place of 98.

invalid.name: body-protected-header-as-empty-map
invalid.description: h'a0', an encoded empty map, as the body protected header. Some COSE libraries write this.

invalid.name: envelope-not-deterministic
invalid.description: The signature array has an indefinite length.

invalid.name: no-signatures
invalid.description: An empty signature array.

invalid.name: signer-unprotected-header-not-empty
invalid.description: The second signer's kid is copied into its unprotected header.

invalid.name: signer-alg-es384
invalid.description: The second signer's alg is -35 (ES384).

invalid.name: signer-alg-label-true
invalid.description: The second signer's alg label is CBOR true, not the integer 1. A decoder whose maps treat true as 1 (Python's dict does) accepts it. A true key can't sort the same way as the text key "player" under both length-first and bytewise order, so a decoder that checks bytewise order refuses it for that. Both faults are malformed.

invalid.name: signer-side-2
invalid.description: The second signer's player is 2. Only sides 0 and 1 exist.

invalid.name: signer-side-as-bool
invalid.description: The second signer's player is CBOR true, not the integer 1.

invalid.name: signer-missing-player
invalid.description: The second signer's header has no player.

invalid.name: signature-63-bytes
invalid.description: The first signature is one byte short.

invalid.name: qr-wrong-prefix
invalid.description: FMR2: before a valid Base45 text.

invalid.name: qr-invalid-base45
invalid.description: A Base45 group of three worth more than 65535 (RFC 9285 section 4.2).

invalid.name: link-standard-base64-padded
invalid.description: The link's envelope in standard base64, with its padding.

invalid.name: envelope-trailing-byte
invalid.description: A zero byte after the envelope.

invalid.name: more-games-than-best-of
invalid.description: Four games in a best of 3.

invalid.name: missing-result-key
invalid.description: No rated (key 3) in the result map.

invalid.name: duplicate-result-key
invalid.description: best_of (key 2) twice in the result map.

invalid.name: unknown-kid-and-tampered-payload
invalid.description: The unknown-kid envelope with iat one second later and both signatures kept. The first signature fails and the second kid is unknown, so unknown_key wins.

invalid.name: unknown-kid-then-short-signature
invalid.description: The first signature is by a key the directory doesn't hold, and the second is 63 bytes. malformed wins.

invalid.name: bad-signature-then-short-signature
invalid.description: The first signature has one bit of s flipped, so it is well formed and fails to verify, and the second is 63 bytes. malformed wins.

invalid.name: points-as-bignum
invalid.description: The first game's first points as 2^64, which only a bignum (tag 2) can hold.
